title_zh: v198：经验协方差候选全过，但同价 identity-GCV 控制也全过
title_en: v198: the empirical-covariance candidate passes, but an equal-cost identity-GCV control also passes
scope_zh: 仅限已经打开的 p22 完整开发轨迹、13 套标定和五/九相机两臂。
scope_en: Limited to the already-opened complete p22 development trajectory, 13 calibrations, and the five/all-nine camera arms.
scientific_question: Does a fit-only empirical coordinate covariance add necessary headroom beyond generic identity-prior GCV when both retain the full per-camera DCT observation and use one unchanged physical CGLS step?
interpretation_zh: 经验协方差候选达到了完整绝对精度门，但 identity-GCV 在相同 2A+1A^T 账下也达到 2626/2626 单元与 26/26 完整组，因此没有证据表明经验协方差是必要成分。更强的开发集线索是：完整 DCT 表示配合简单正则可以修复 full-DCT K1 父方法剩余的 3 个五相机单元；但 identity-GCV 在全部单元选择同一 tau，当前结果也没有证明逐观测自适应本身不可替代。
interpretation_en: The empirical-covariance candidate clears the complete absolute-accuracy gate, but identity-GCV also reaches 2626/2626 cells and 26/26 groups at the same 2A+1AT ledger. There is therefore no evidence that empirical covariance is necessary. The stronger development-set clue is that full-DCT coordinates plus simple regularization repair the three remaining five-camera cells of the full-DCT K1 parent. Because identity-GCV selects the same tau for every cell, this result also does not establish that per-observation adaptation is necessary.
decision_boundary_zh: 这是已打开 p22 开发轨迹上的控制归因，不是 p14 验证、外部泛化、fresh wall/RSS、真实 BOST 或论文成功。经验协方差路线关闭；不能把同价控制通过包装成协方差创新。
decision_boundary_en: This is control attribution on the already-opened p22 development trajectory, not p14 validation, external generalization, fresh wall/RSS, real BOST, or paper success. The empirical-covariance route closes; an equal-cost control pass cannot be repackaged as covariance innovation.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 先把 p22 开发结果蒸馏成唯一固定的 identity-prior 正则候选，并在读取 p14 前冻结一次性验证合同；必须保留 full-DCT K1、v197 K2 reference、便宜控制、完整调用账和独立第二实现。
next_scientific_gate_en: Distill the p22 development result into one fixed identity-prior regularized candidate and freeze a one-shot validation contract before reading p14. Retain the full-DCT K1 parent, the v197 K2 reference, cheap controls, complete call accounting, and an independent second implementation.
